offer.title: Public offer
offer.intro: This document is the official offer (public offer) of the Bigmax online store (bigmax.uz) and contains all material terms for the sale of goods.
offer.s1Body: By placing an order on the site, the buyer fully accepts the terms of this offer. The seller reserves the right to make changes; the current version is always available on this page.
offer.s2Body: The seller transfers ownership of goods listed in the catalog to the buyer, who accepts and pays for them at the prices stated at the time of order.
offer.s3Body: All prices are listed in soum (UZS) and include VAT. Payment is made online by card, by bank transfer, or in cash to the courier on delivery.
offer.s4Body: Delivery is available across Uzbekistan. Times and costs are calculated at checkout based on the region.
offer.s5Body: The buyer may return goods of proper quality within 14 days of receipt. See the Support page for details.

agreement.title: User agreement
agreement.intro: This agreement governs the relationship between the Bigmax online store and the user of bigmax.uz.
agreement.s1Body: By registering or using the site, the user confirms acceptance of all terms of this agreement.
agreement.s2Body: The user is responsible for the accuracy of their data and the security of their account. Report unauthorized access to support immediately.
agreement.s3Body: Bigmax undertakes to maintain the operation of the service. The user undertakes not to violate applicable law and not to use the site to harm third parties.
agreement.s4Body: All site materials, including texts, images and logos, are owned by Bigmax or used with permission of the rights holders.
agreement.s5Body: The service is provided "as is". Bigmax is not liable for damage arising from improper use of the site.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Bigmax respects your privacy and processes personal data in strict accordance with the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
privacy.s1Body: Name, phone, email, delivery address, order history, technical browser and device data.
privacy.s2Body: Order processing and delivery, customer support, promotional notifications, analytics and service improvement.
privacy.s3Body: We share data only with delivery and payment providers required to fulfill an order, or upon request from government authorities.
privacy.s4Body: Data is stored on secure servers. We apply technical and organizational measures to protect it from unauthorized access.
privacy.s5Body: You can request access, modification or deletion of your data by writing to support@bigmax.uz.
